title: The Bridge That Halved Itself
story: Glacemaw the Thaw Wyrm breathes warm mist over the glacier, and the ice bridge holding forty stranded sheep loses half its thickness every hour. The shepherds panic; Mr 6 measures with his sword and thinks in halves. Below thirty centimeters the bridge will not hold a sheep.
question: The ice bridge is 480 centimeters thick and halves every hour. How many hours until it becomes exactly 30 centimeters thick?
hint: Halve 480 over and over, counting each halving, until you hit 30.
victory: Mr 6 got every sheep across with a full hour to spare, and Glacemaw — impressed by the arithmetic — froze the bridge back solid just to see him do it again.
imagePrompt: A pale steaming wyrm coils over a blue glacier while a numeral-six knight hurries woolly sheep across a thinning ice bridge, dawn light glittering on the crevasse below.
